payload.rationale: Fix hard-gate failures with minimal changes: (1) repair id_integrity by replacing architecture option risk free-text with valid risk_register IDs (or empty lists where no matching IDs exist), and (2) satisfy risk_closure by adding mitigation and acceptance text for critical risk K8.

value.text: Add explicit user-facing safety messaging: document that generated outputs may expose private notes when hosted publicly; include a prominent pre-build warning in CLI help/docs; provide and document exclusion/ignore configuration patterns (e.g., ignore private folders/files) and generate a build report listing all included source files so users can review what will be published.

patch.value: Docs/CLI help contain a prominent warning about public hosting exposure; build output includes a human-readable manifest/report enumerating included files and configured excludes, enabling user review before deployment.
